scope: Two coarse fixed scan-end observation checks; insufficient levels for convergence
runnerText:
"""Two coarse P4 observation checks before the separate five-case series."""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "python"))
from lpbf_simulation import implementation_fingerprint, run
from lpbf_peak import interpolated_peak_melt_pool
from lpbf_fixed_scan_end_observation import write_selected_state_artifact
from run_lpbf_fixed_scan_end_convergence import preflight, _row_from_result

REPORT = ROOT / "docs/LPBF_P4_FIXED_SCAN_END_OBSERVATION_CHECK_2026-09-27.json"
FIELDS = ROOT / "docs/LPBF_P4_FIXED_SCAN_END_OBSERVATION_CHECK_FIELDS_2026-09-27"
protocol, scenario, specs, frozen, _, _, _, protocol_sha, _ = preflight()
if REPORT.exists() or FIELDS.exists():
    raise ValueError("Preserve existing observation-check evidence")
FIELDS.mkdir()
report = {"schemaVersion": 1,
          "scope": "Two coarse fixed scan-end observation checks; insufficient levels for convergence",
          "experimentalValidation": False, "convergenceStatus": "unvalidated",
          "protocolSha256": protocol_sha, "implementationHash": frozen,
          "runnerSha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "runnerText": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
          "executionHead": subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT,
                                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip(),
          "rows": [], "stage": "running"}


def save():
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


save()
for spec in specs:
    if spec["mesh_um"] not in (20, 10):
        continue
    payload = copy.deepcopy(scenario)
    payload.update(mesh_um=spec["mesh_um"], maxDt_s=spec["maxDt_s"])
    before = implementation_fingerprint()
    assert before == frozen
    captured = []
    started = time.perf_counter()
    result = run(payload, selected_time_observer=captured.append,
                 selected_time_s=protocol["targetTime_s"])
    duration = time.perf_counter() - started
    after = implementation_fingerprint()
    assert len(captured) == 1 and after == before
    state = captured[0]
    contour = interpolated_peak_melt_pool(
        state["coordinates_m"], state["temperature_K"], protocol["surfaceZ_m"],
        payload["scanAngle_deg"], result["discretization"]["mesh_m"],
        result["material"]["liquidus_K"])
    contour.update(temporalSelection=protocol["temporalSelection"],
                   observationOperator=protocol["contourOperator"],
                   targetTime_s=state["target_time_s"], actualTime_s=state["time_s"],
                   targetMinusActualTime_s=state["time_difference_s"],
                   roundoffTolerance_s=state["roundoff_tolerance_s"])
    artifact = write_selected_state_artifact(state, FIELDS / f"mesh-{spec['mesh_um']}um.npz")
    row = _row_from_result(spec, result, contour, artifact, before, after, frozen)
    row["wallSeconds"] = duration
    report["rows"].append(row)
    save()
    print(json.dumps({"mesh_um": spec["mesh_um"], "cells": row["cells"],
                      "steps": row["steps"], "contour": contour,
                      "energyError": row["energyBalance"]["relativeError"],
                      "wall_s": duration}), flush=True)
report["stage"] = "completed"
report["implementationFingerprintAtEnd"] = implementation_fingerprint()
assert report["implementationFingerprintAtEnd"] == frozen
save()
